_comment: The two tags that make a profile one of the reader's Assistants (Settings › Assistants & Duties, read through config/assistants). The same two Tapestry's My Assistants page reads (nous-clawds4/tapestry src/lib/my-assistant-tags, 2026-10-01): keep them in step, so a tagging made on either app shows on both.
_tags: In the order a row shows them. A tagging counts by its tag's slug, whoever authored the definition (Tapestry's rule, ADR my-assistants/0001): the coordinate is what a new tagging points at, not a filter.
